biocs.name: Globally Uncommon IP Connection from Signed Process
biocs.description: Detection of a signed process initiating a network connection to an IP address that is not commonly seen in the organization's network traffic.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_process_image_name != null
| filter action_remote_ip != null
| filter action_process_image_name matches '.*signed.*'
| comp count() as events by action_remote_ip, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

abiocs.name: Unusual Network Behavior from Trusted Process
